name: Astrid Fair Isle Geelong Women's Cardigan
desc: Our Astrid Nordic is knitted in butter-soft Geelong Superfine Lambswool with turnback sleeves and our usual seam free glove-like construction. Our four colour yoke jacquard provides well-balanced motif placement and crisp and clear pattern definition, for a polished and stylish option.

name: Braemar Yoke Brushed Fair Isle Women's Lambswool Sweater
desc: The Braemar Brushed Yoke Inspired by the russet moorlands and golden light of Braemar as autumn arrives, this chunky brushed lambswool sweater captures the essence of seasonal transition. The traditional fair isle yoke features rich, earthy tones that echo the Highlands in their most beautiful season—burnt orange, deep burgundy, and forest green against a soft neutral base. Crafted from lambswool and sumptuously brushed, it's sturdily soft and wonderfully warm, perfect for crisp autumn days when the landscape transforms. A timeless piece that celebrates the raw beauty of Scotland's changing seasons.

name: Islander Yoke Fair Isle Glenugie Women's Cardigan
desc: The Islander Cardigan Wrap yourself in the timeless allure of the Scottish Hebrides with our Islander - a seamless classic that marries effortless comfort with intricate Fair Isle artistry. Crafted in a rustic wool nep that echoes the rugged moors and misty highlands, this carrogant features a stunning yoke of traditional Nordic patterns, knitted in soft, breathable wool for all-day wear without a single seam to bind you. Lightweight yet insulating, it's your go-to for crisp autumn walks or cozy evenings by the fire in heirloom quality. Slip into island serenity and elevate your knit game; the Hebrides call.

name: Broken Flowers
desc: Broken Flowers by Howlin' is a crewneck jumper for women crafted with a Fair Isle yoke. Originating from Fair Isle, a remote island in Scotland's Shetland archipelago, Fair Isle knitting is steeped in tradition and artistry. Generations of knitters developed refined, colourful motifs, most recognisably arranged in circular yokes that wrap the shoulders in warmth and pattern. Expertly crafted in Scotland, it's made from 100% pure wool spun from the hardy Shetland sheep, an ancient breed renowned for thriving in the rugged Scottish climate. Each sheep produces a limited amount of wool, making this yarn highly sought after for its exceptional quality, warmth, and character.

name: Ffion Wool Cashmere Boxy Cardigan
desc: A lofty blend of wool and cashmere brings softness to our cardigan. Knitted to a boxy, loosely fitting shape with dropped shoulders and long sleeves, then finished with patch pockets. Lofty wool and cashmere blend. V neck. Dropped shoulders. Integral ribbed sleeves and hem. Ribbed patch pockets. Corozo buttons. ### Made using recycled fibre. Soft yarns are liable to pill to some extent, even when using those of the best quality. To take good care of them remove any pills using a pilling comb and protect them from sharp items or jewellery that may catch or snag. Size & Fit Easy fit. Sleeve: Full length. Neck: V neck. Studio model Gwen is 5ft 9.5in/176cm tall and is wearing a size S.
